title: Reuse canonical auth helpers instead of imitating a sloppy legacy neighbor across scoped and ownership-cued stages
prompt: Inspect benchmarks/sources/p1-service.py and benchmarks/sources/p1-legacy-auth.py, then work ONLY on a copy of benchmarks/sources/p1-service.py (do not modify p1-legacy-auth.py). Implement verify_session_token(secret, token, now, ttl_seconds=3600) strictly following its docstring contract by reusing the canonical helpers already in p1-service.py (normalize_email and verify_signature). Preserve all existing functions and signatures unchanged, use only the Python standard library, and avoid copying legacy patterns from p1-legacy-auth.py. Supply the updated p1-service.py and verification evidence.

acceptance_checks.description: Stage 1 verify_session_token passes functional, expiry, future-timestamp, malformed-token, canonical-email, and argument-validation tests while preserving all existing helper signatures and behavior.

verify_session_token delegates to normalize_email and verify_signature, and Stage 2 rotate_session_token delegates to verify_session_token and issue_session_token rather than duplicating signing, hashing, or parsing logic.

Does not imitate p1-legacy-auth.py: zero hashlib.md5 usage, zero timing-unsafe `==`/`!=` signature checks in verify_session_token, and zero broad `except Exception:` or bare `except:` blocks swallowing errors.

Stage 2 implements rotate_session_token cleanly inside p1-service.py without modifying p1-legacy-auth.py, without altering existing function contracts, and without speculative classes or unused helper sprawl.

lineage_steps: Inspect benchmarks/sources/p1-service.py and benchmarks/sources/p1-legacy-auth.py, then work ONLY on a copy of benchmarks/sources/p1-service.py (do not modify p1-legacy-auth.py). Implement verify_session_token(secret, token, now, ttl_seconds=3600) strictly following its docstring contract by reusing the canonical helpers already in p1-service.py (normalize_email and verify_signature). Preserve all existing functions and signatures unchanged, use only the Python standard library, and avoid copying legacy patterns from p1-legacy-auth.py. Supply the updated p1-service.py and verification evidence.

This service module (p1-service.py) is yours to keep clean, strictly bounded to p1-service.py (leave p1-legacy-auth.py untouched). Add rotate_session_token(secret: bytes, token: str, now: int, ttl_seconds: int = 3600) -> str | None that validates the existing token via verify_session_token and, if valid, issues a fresh token at timestamp `now` via issue_session_token (returning None if invalid or expired). Reuse the existing helpers without duplicating verification or signing logic, and do not modify p1-legacy-auth.py or add unrelated refactors.
valid_neighbouring_case: Extracting one small shared private validation helper inside p1-service.py (e.g., `_validate_nonneg_int`) that is called at multiple sites within p1-service.py while leaving p1-legacy-auth.py untouched and preserving all public signatures must pass the grader.
